ideas.name: with yesterday's 10-year yield move (falling yields, long)
ideas.why: falling yields lift long-duration tech; the day's flow leans long, rising yields short

ideas.name: with the dollar's week (weaker dollar, long)
ideas.why: a weaker dollar loosens conditions and lifts risk assets; the drift favours longs

ideas.name: with credit's week (spreads narrowing, long)
ideas.why: narrowing high-yield spreads are risk appetite; equities follow credit

ideas.name: VIX below VIX3M (a calm curve)
ideas.why: an inverted curve is panic: whipsaws both ways; breakouts need an orderly market

ideas.name: VXN up over the last 5 sessions
ideas.why: rising fear makes dealers shorter gamma; they hedge with the move and breakouts extend

ideas.name: VXN high relative to VIX (above 1.25)
ideas.why: tech-specific volatility: NQ moving on its own story trends harder than on the market's

ideas.name: with leveraged funds' net NQ position
ideas.why: trend followers' positioning is the trend's fuel; breakouts its way have them adding

ideas.name: with the change in leveraged funds' net
ideas.why: funds adding to a side are actively buying (selling) through the week
